prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Miami FL to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for all of Miami—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, home type, and price range. A useful starting point is Zillow’s [Miami agent directory](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/miami-fl/), where you can compare recent sales, seller reviews, and local experience. Realtor.com also has a [Miami agent directory](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents/Miami_FL).

For example, the directory results include **Dinorah de Cardenas (RESF)**, listed with 22 team sales in the prior 12 months. That’s a lead to investigate, not a definitive endorsement—team sales may not reflect the individual agent’s own work.

Interview three agents who have recently sold homes like yours nearby. Ask for:
- Recent comparable listings and closed sales in your neighborhood
- Their suggested list price and the evidence behind it
- A marketing plan, including photography and open houses
- Their commission and contract terms
- Who will handle showings, offers, and negotiations

If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, property type, and approximate price range, I can help narrow down what to look for.
